description: Fragment-handling boundaries. A supplied https target carrying a non-empty fragment is rejected directly with invalid_uri ('must not contain a fragment'), independent of scheme. A target ending in a bare '#' has an EMPTY fragment component (not rejected); processing then continues and, since state is enforced by default, the state-required error is reported back via the rebuilt target.

cases.expected_output:
response=0
status=400
type=response
body.error=invalid_uri
body.error_description=The redirect URI must not contain a fragment

response=0
status=302
type=redirect
redirect.scheme=http
redirect.user=
redirect.host=adobe.com
redirect.port=
redirect.path=
redirect.fragment=?error=invalid_request&error_description=The+state+parameter+is+required
